correctness.rationale: For closed-neighborhood Boolean update (up,down)=(1,3), a permutation order induces an acyclic orientation; the Macauley–Mortveit cycle-equivalence theorem and single click-equivalence class on trees allow one canonical order per tree. The leaf-augmentation generator with AHU rooted-center canonical tree codes exhausts every unlabeled tree. The C++ code builds every one-sweep successor for every one of 2^n masks and traverses functional graph cycles without skipping transient components; its class counts agree with known unlabeled-tree numbers. Crucially, an independently implemented exhaustive NetworkX nonisomorphic-tree generator and separate C++ state-sweep analysis reproduced for all n=1..14 all 5,447 isomorphism classes, all 65,293,454 finite states, maxima (1,1,1,1,2,3,6,10,14,22,42,58,86,106), maximizing class counts, and orbit counts. The 14-vertex witness states are also given in the inspected trace and witness replay script. Thus the bounded theorem is exhaustive, not sample extrapolation.
